items.title: Yemen escalation fuels fears of further cholera, measles spread
items.summary: Heavy fighting in Yemen is fuelling concerns of an uptick in cholera, measles and other preventable diseases, as overcrowding at displacement sites threatens to overwhelm the limited healthcare services still open.

items.title: Department of War and RTX Accelerate Advanced Medium-Range Air-to-Air Missile Production Through $20.7B Award
items.summary: The War Department announced an award to Raytheon, an RTX business, a contract valued up to $20.7 billion to produce advanced medium-range air-to-air missiles, a critical air defense capability for U.S. and allied forces.
